svg.text: Pipe and filter — product data enrichment platform
Dashed outline = designed, not yet built
ETIM reference layer — 10 tables, ETIM 10.0 EI, loaded and queryable; pinned (ADR-013, ADR-020)
Matching decomposed — one matcher becomes class → feature → value/unit → validation (ADR-016)
Staging split — supplier evidence and ETIM interpretation in separate tables (ADR-014)
Explicit ingestion → ML seam — frozen ExtractedInput record, no interpretation crosses (ADR-021)
PIMS contract re-keyed — on product + ETIM release + class + feature (ADR-017)
Unchanged from v5.0: the pipe-and-filter spine, per-attribute routing granularity, human-in-the-loop, append-only audit.
Parse · Azure Doc Intelligence OCR · normalize
frozen handoff record · evidence only, no confidence
original value, unit, page, row, source text
PredictionServiceInterface — the interface boundary is unchanged (ADR-002); what sits behind it is decomposed (ADR-016)
ETIM IDs · typed values · confidence per assignment
class-review-first, then per attribute on the full ETIM signal set:
class conf · match conf · ETIM validity · client policy · unit conversion
low confidence, invalid, or required field missing
ETIM IDs + normalized value + original value + evidence + confidence
Product information management system — now ETIM-keyed
append-only · every routing and review decision
now also records suggested class / feature / value,
validation status, and the ETIM release in force
a reviewer's decision resolves the same
Built and merged: ETIM reference layer (Alembic 0005) · evidence staging split (0006) · extracted_inputs handoff (0007).
Designed, not yet built: the matching stages, ETIM-aware routing, and the re-keyed writeback (EPARTS-289–295, 299).
